test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two trains each 200 m long are moving in opposite directions. They cross each other in 10 seconds. If the speed of one train is 90 km/h, find the speed of the other train.
solution:
**Given:**

Two trains each 200 m long are moving in opposite directions. 

They cross each other in 10 seconds or 1/360 hours

The speed of one train is 90 km/h

**Concept used:**

Relative speed (while moving in opp. direction) = x + y

**Calculations:**

&
lt;p>Total length = 200 + 200 = 400 m or 0.4 km

Let the speed of the other train be x 

When crossed each other (moving in opp. direction)

Distance traveled = 400 m

x + 90 = 0.4/(1/360)

⇒ x = (0.4 × 360) - 90

⇒ x = 144 - 90 = 54 km/h

**∴ The speed of the other train is 54 km/h.**
